method: All current tracked/unignored files, staged added/modified blobs, and unique file blobs in every commit origin/main..HEAD; local secret exact matching plus token/private-key/credential patterns. No secret values recorded.

review.reason: Matches originated only from the example file itself; none equals live .env credentials. Example values were incorrectly included in the initial scanner secret set.
mysql_url_safe is a formatted string containing a literal masked password (three asterisks), not a credential.

limitations: Pattern scanning is not a proof that every possible credential format is absent. New release edits remain uncommitted; recheck the final index and exact outgoing commit range before any future push.
